products.title: Vintage Pendleton Board Shirt

images.alt: Vintage Pendleton Board Shirt, green and navy plaid

details.care: Dry clean, or spot clean and air out.

products.description:
A 1980s Pendleton Board Shirt in a green and navy plaid, loop collar, the big flap pockets and the blue woven label. The wool is pure virgin wool, dense and smooth, the kind that gets better with a decade of autumns.

No holes, no moth tracks, colors still deep. The lower button was replaced at some point with a near match. Dry cleaned before listing.

products.title: Fern Field Tee

images.alt: Fern Field Tee, white fern fronds on deep blue cotton
Detail of the lady fern print

details.care: Cold wash inside out, line dry in shade. The blue deepens with the first few washes.
details.fit: Relaxed, true to a modern medium
details.origin: Printed by hand in Northeast Ohio

products.description:
A heavyweight cotton tee printed with lady fern fronds gathered from the creek bank behind the studio. The fronds were laid flat on the shirt and left in full sun for twenty minutes, so every spore dot and curled tip is there in white against deep blue.

The shirt was secondhand before it was blue: soft, broken in, no holes. The print wraps slightly over the left shoulder. One of one.

products.title: Queen Anne's Lace Linen Dress

images.alt: Queen Anne's Lace Linen Dress, front
Queen Anne's Lace Linen Dress, detail of the umbels

details.care: Cold wash inside out, line dry in shade. The blue deepens with the first few washes. Iron on the reverse while damp.
details.fit: Straight shift, roomy through the hip
details.origin: Printed by hand in Northeast Ohio

products.description:
A sleeveless linen shift printed with Queen Anne's lace cut the same morning it was exposed. The umbels sit across the chest and scatter down the skirt, each tiny floret showing as a point of white. Linen takes the chemistry unevenly, so the blue has a soft, watery grain to it.

Side seam pockets, a short back slit, and a bias-bound neckline. The dress itself was deadstock from an Ohio sewing shop that closed in 2019. One of one.

products.title: Vintage Lee Cutoffs

details.fit: High rise, straight through the hip
details.condition: Very good vintage: soft fading, one small paint fleck, no holes

products.description:
1980s Lee Riders, cut to a long short and finished with a single turned cuff. Medium wash with honest fading down the front of the thighs and a small paint fleck on the back right pocket.

High rise, zip fly, the original leather patch still legible. We measured them flat; please check your own pair against the numbers before ordering.

products.title: Meadow Grass Button-Up

images.alt: Meadow Grass Button-Up with grass seed heads up the front

details.care: Cold wash inside out, line dry in shade. The blue deepens with the first few washes.
details.fit: Boxy camp shirt, wear it open or buttoned
details.origin: Printed by hand in Northeast Ohio

products.description:
A camp-collar cotton shirt printed with timothy grass and orchard grass seed heads from the field at the end of our road. The stems run up the front panels and over the pocket like a tall August meadow. The back is plain blue.

Coconut buttons, straight hem, a single chest pocket. The shirt came from a church rummage sale with the tags still on. Marked down because one cuff took the sun a little brighter than the other, which we like.

products.title: Pressed Fern Tote

images.alt: Pressed Fern Tote, canvas with a bracken fern print

details.care: Spot clean or cold wash, line dry in shade.
details.origin: Printed by hand in Northeast Ohio

products.description:
A natural canvas tote printed with a pressed bracken fern on one side. The fern was flattened in a book for a week so the print is crisp right out to the smallest leaflet. The other side is plain.

Doubled cotton web handles, a flat bottom, and room for a big grocery run or a laptop and a sweater. Printed in small batches.

products.title: Cyanotype Tea Towel Pair

images.alt: Cyanotype Tea Towel Pair, dill and fern

details.care: Warm wash, tumble or line dry. Avoid bleach and strong detergent.
details.origin: Printed by hand in Northeast Ohio

products.description:
Two flour-sack cotton tea towels, one printed with sprigs of dill and one with a single fern frond. Absorbent, lint free, and sized for a real kitchen. The pair arrives tied with cotton tape.

They will lighten a little with hot water and sun, like all cyanotype, which we think looks better each year. Hemmed on all four sides with a hanging loop.

products.title: Maple & Moon Bandana

details.care: Cold wash, line dry in shade. The blue deepens with the first few washes.
details.origin: Printed by hand in Northeast Ohio

products.description:
A 22 inch cotton bandana printed with a single sugar maple leaf and a paper circle for the moon. The leaf is from the big tree by the studio door; the moon is cut by hand so no two are quite the same size.

Hand-rolled hem, soft after one wash. Tie it on a bag strap, wear it in your hair, or wrap a gift in it. We print these in small batches of four to six at a time.

products.title: Wild Carrot Slip Dress

images.alt: Wild Carrot Slip Dress, bias cut

details.care: Cold wash inside out, line dry in shade. The blue deepens with the first few washes.
details.origin: Printed by hand in Northeast Ohio

products.description:
A bias-cut cotton slip dress printed with wild carrot in flower and seed, gathered along a roadside in late July. The flowering heads cluster at the hem and the curled seed heads climb toward the waist. The bias cut makes the dress move, and the print moves with it.

Adjustable straps and a deep V at the back. The dress was a 1990s department store piece, never worn. One of one.

products.title: Cosmos Chore Jacket

details.care: Cold wash inside out, line dry in shade. The blue deepens with the first few washes.
details.origin: Printed by hand in Northeast Ohio

products.description:
A cotton drill chore jacket printed with cosmos flowers and their feathery leaves from the cutting bed. The flowers were pressed overnight first so the petals print flat and sharp; the foliage was laid fresh for a looser, softer edge. The print covers the back and the two lower pockets.

Three patch pockets, corozo buttons, and a boxy cut. The jacket was a 1990s French work jacket before it was blue. One of one.

products.title: Sun Print Notebook

details.fabric: Cotton rag paper cover, 120 gsm text pages
details.origin: Printed by hand in Northeast Ohio

products.description:
An A5 notebook with a cyanotype paper cover, each one printed with a different sprig from the garden: fennel, fern, clover, whatever is good that week. Sixty-four pages of plain, heavy cream paper that takes fountain pen ink without bleeding.

Saddle stitched with waxed linen thread. The cover is sealed so the print will not rub off in a bag.

products.title: 1970s Wool Cardigan

details.care: Hand wash cold, lay flat to dry.
details.condition: Good vintage: gentle felting, light pilling under the arms

products.description:
A shawl-collar wool cardigan in oatmeal with brown leather-look buttons, made in the USA in the mid 1970s. Chunky, warm, and slightly felted from decades of wear, which keeps it from itching.

Two patch pockets, ribbed cuffs, and no moth damage that we could find after a careful look in daylight. Freshly hand washed and reshaped.
